By purchase type (on 11-12 vs 11-05): Subscription -16.6%, Pay as you go -10.3%. The drop was already visible in new subs a week ago, so lifting new subs now is what turns revenue around next week.

insights.title: Revenue by purchase type — App Total Revenue -6.8% — down mainly in Subscription (-5,199, -7.4%).
insights.body: App Total Revenue was 70,130, against 75,275 for the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks (-5,145). By purchase type: Subscription -5,199 (-7.4%), Pay as you go +53 (+1.1%). Pay as you go is 6.9% of revenue. Subscription is the recurring part fed by new subs about a week earlier; look at new subs and renewals.

insights.title: Purchase type by app — Subscription revenue is falling most in YMK (-10.5%), while YCV grows (+8.1%).
insights.body: By app: the biggest Subscription fall is YMK -3,501 (-10.5%, about 44% of revenue); the biggest Subscription gain is YCV +630 (+8.1%); Pay as you go moved most in YCP -696 (-53.4%); YCV relies most on Pay as you go (15% of its revenue vs 6.9% overall). Subscription is the recurring revenue that new subs feed; Pay as you go is one-off spend.

insights.title: Purchase type by country — Subscription revenue is falling most in US (-6.1%), while BR grows (+6.9%).
insights.body: By country: the biggest Subscription fall is US -1,746 (-6.1%, about 41% of revenue); the biggest Subscription gain is BR +211 (+6.9%); Pay as you go moved most in JP -404 (-25.9%); JP relies most on Pay as you go (30% of its revenue vs 6.9% overall). Subscription is the recurring revenue that new subs feed; Pay as you go is one-off spend.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YCP is turning installs into New Subs better than usual (-48.6% vs Install -87.7%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCP New Subs -48.6% vs Install -87.7% (better than its installs); YMK New Subs -11.1% vs Install +1.8% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which app — App Total New User -10.7% is mostly YCP — not every app.
insights.body: App Total New User moved -10.7% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -10.7%, YMK +1.9%, YCP -82.3%, YCV -7.2%). YCP accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Market trend — US is losing ground fast on turning installs into subs (-10.2%, now 12.4%).
insights.body: In US, 12.4% of installs now turn into new subs — -10.2% versus last period. It is about 41% of revenue (a big revenue market): fewer of the people downloading are subscribing, and revenue will feel that within a week or two.

insights.title: Install mix — Where installs come from is shifting away from SEO Install (-22.0% vs -10.3% for installs overall).
insights.body: SEO Install was 1,163, -22.0% against the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks, while total installs moved -10.3% — a difference of -11.7 percentage points. SEO Install is now 5.6% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving away from it; free traffic slipping while paid holds up means we are buying more of the same installs..
